instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot from a slightly high angle. In a mossy green forest, a white duvet is spread on the ground. The woman in the blue striped shirt (R1) sits on the left, facing right and looking at her companion with a gentle smile, her right hand resting near her collarbone. The man in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on the right, facing left and looking down pensively with a neutral expression. They sit close together on the white bedding, sharing a quiet, intimate moment outdoors. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a cool palette of greens and whites.
